cover.coreProposition: Complete authority evidence can make planning possible but cannot authorize execution; a current intent-bound mutation guard must separately decide whether the effect may occur.
cover.visualMetaphor: A luminous evidence lens reveals a path, while a separate amber gate controls whether the path can cross into the external world.
cover.semanticObject: Cyan evidence lens facing a distinct amber execution gate over a dark navy boundary
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a deep navy field, layered cyan evidence planes, one clearly separate amber gate, subtle violet depth, and generous negative space
